summary: Layer 1B expansion found a credible underfollowed lane around electrical construction, medium-voltage switchgear, utility load growth, and conduit/cable-management inputs. The clearest second-order chokepoint evidence is that data-center and AI power demand is stressing transformer, substation, and grid interconnection timelines; candidates below are research leads only, not buy/sell recommendations.
